properties.displayName: Harbourline AI guardrail: Foundry and AI Services accounts must disable key-based (local) authentication
properties.description: Denies Microsoft.CognitiveServices/accounts (Foundry, Azure OpenAI, AI Services) unless disableLocalAuth is true. Every caller must use Entra ID (managed identity or user token). A leaked key is then worthless because there is no key. Alias: Microsoft.CognitiveServices/accounts/disableLocalAuth (same alias as the built-in 'Cognitive Services accounts should have local authentication methods disabled').

metadata.description: Deny blocks the deployment; Audit only reports.
